mainline_verdict: This lane does not prove Pre-A from observations. It tests existence, quotient identifiability, stability, and predictivity of microscopic structures allowed by observations. Even a pass cannot establish cosmic origin or a theory of everything before common forward dynamics, a physical sector, uniform continuum control, and an independent prospective prediction all close.

source_rules: Record the source edition, publication or release date, accessed date, exact data product, and local hash before scoring.
Do not turn sensitivity summaries, posterior summaries, or correlated derived rows into independent Gaussian observations.
The SI value of c is a unit definition and calibration, not evidence for Lorentz invariance.
Gauge symmetry, Ward or Slavnov-Taylor identities, anomaly cancellation, spectral positivity, and microcausality are effective-target constraints rather than detector observations.

inverse_test_contract.existence: Find a nonempty feasible set under the joint calibration likelihood/covariance and theory-error budget; otherwise NO_FEASIBLE_MEMBER.
inverse_test_contract.structural_identifiability: Test injectivity only after quotienting gauge, diffeomorphism, RG, field-redefinition, and prediction-preserving regulator/scheme equivalences.
inverse_test_contract.practical_identifiability: Report the predictive diameter of the confidence or posterior set and search for separated global twins; a Jacobian rank test alone is insufficient.
inverse_test_contract.stability: Bound changes of the surviving set and holdout prediction under covariance, nuisance, theory-transform, regulator, boundary, volume, and limit-order perturbations.
inverse_test_contract.predictivity: Use a proper predictive score against the frozen M0 baseline on an unused prospective target; training best fit is not a final score.
inverse_test_contract.uniform_limit: Prove common-core uniform control and compare infer-then-limit with limit-then-infer before any infinite-limit interpretation.

reference_only_crosswalk.a3_boundary: The restricted scalar perturbative spectral-continuum results are baseline pointers only and are not full production TECT or Yang-Mills continuum results.

hostile_test_contract.mutation: Change a holdout value after freeze.
Duplicate a statistic from the same raw source.
Use distinct mobilities with the same static Gibbs law.
Change candidate, nuisance, scorer, or map hash.
Change regulator, boundary, or limit order and flip survival.
Generate data from M0 and run the selection pipeline.
Use an observation anchor instead of owner-approved E and common functional.
Promote several finite rows to an infinite-limit result.
Let good fit compensate for a missing owner or map stage.

synthesis_policy.reason: This is an input and route contract, not a gate-level scientific result.
synthesis_policy.single_checkpoint_trigger: Issue one synthesis note/PDF only after the first complete microscopic forward map is admitted and the observation/target/holdout freeze changes gate state, or after a candidate is prospectively falsified or survives.

stop_and_redesign: If no candidate has a complete forward map, stop empirical scoring and return to owner/map construction.
If the inverse is nonidentifiable, report the surviving equivalence class and design a separating observable.
If theory or map uncertainty exceeds candidate separation, improve the forward theorem and error bound before adding data.
If a proof filtration or q ledger is chosen to fit observations, create a new candidate version; do not call it A13 closure.
If holdout power is insufficient or all candidates share the baseline law, report NO_SELECTION.
If a holdout fails, do not retune in the same round.
If the common physical action, source owner, or physical-empty E is absent, park that branch.
If a uniform estimate fails, retain only the finite evidence level and record the failure boundary.
non_claims: No observation packet is yet locally hash-frozen and no candidate has been scored.
No microscopic candidate is admitted and no uniqueness, stability, or prospective prediction is established.
No Reading-H physical-empty sign, C6, Pre-A, A13, Sector-A, physical-sector, thermodynamic, continuum, Yang-Mills, gravity, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything, or mass-gap claim is advanced.
Finite TECT and TECT-YM results remain finite, conditional, auxiliary, or reference-only at their existing evidence levels.
next_gate: Hash-freeze the exact source/data products and candidate-neutral estimands, then admit one complete candidate forward map through F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs before any scoring.
